tools.name: search_assets
tools.title: Search tradable assets
tools.description: Find which assets this tracker can query: searches Binance USDT spot markets by name fragment and returns matching pairs with price, 24h change and volume. Use before other tools when unsure of a ticker.

tools.name: get_market_snapshot
tools.title: Get market snapshot
tools.description: Live 24h price snapshot for a crypto asset (price, % change, high/low, volume) sourced from Binance spot markets.

symbol.description: Asset or pair, e.g. 'BTC', 'SOL' or 'BTCUSDT'. Defaults to USDT quote.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.title: Get price history (OHLCV)
tools.description: Historical candles (open/high/low/close/volume) for a crypto asset from Binance spot, oldest first. Use for charting, trend checks, or feeding your own analysis.

tools.name: get_top_movers
tools.title: Get top movers
tools.description: Biggest 24h gainers, losers or volume leaders across Binance USDT spot markets, filtered to reasonably liquid pairs.

min_volume_usd.description: Minimum 24h quote volume in USD. Default 5000000.

tools.name: compare_exchange_prices
tools.title: Compare prices across exchanges
tools.description: Live price of an asset on Binance, OKX, Bybit, Kraken and Hyperliquid side by side, with the cheapest/priciest venues and the cross-exchange spread in percent (arbitrage lead, not a verified opportunity — see the response's own note field).

tools.name: get_whale_trades
tools.title: Get whale trades
tools.description: Recent large ('whale') trades for an asset: aggregated Binance trades filtered by a minimum USD notional, newest first.

min_usd.description: Minimum trade size in USD. Default 100000.

tools.name: get_trade_flow
tools.title: Get buy/sell trade flow
tools.description: Aggressive buy vs sell volume for an asset over the most recent trades: notional split, delta, average trade size and the resulting flow bias.

trades.description: How many recent trades to analyse, 100-1000. Default 1000.

tools.name: get_orderbook_pressure
tools.title: Get order book pressure
tools.description: Live order book imbalance for an asset: total bid vs ask liquidity near the spread and the resulting buy/sell pressure bias.

depth.description: Number of book levels per side, 5-100. Default 50.

tools.name: get_funding_and_open_interest
tools.title: Get funding rate & open interest
tools.description: Perpetual futures positioning for an asset: current funding rate, mark vs index price, open interest, and the top-trader long/short account ratio from Binance futures.

symbol.description: Asset or perpetual pair, e.g. 'BTC' or 'BTCUSDT'.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_market
tools.title: Get Hyperliquid perp market
tools.description: Live Hyperliquid perpetual data for an asset: mark price, 24h change and volume, funding rate, open interest and max leverage. Omit the symbol to get the busiest markets.

symbol.description: Base asset, e.g. 'BTC'. Omit for a top-markets list.

limit.description: Markets to return when no symbol is given, 1-25. Default 10.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_wallet
tools.title: Get Hyperliquid wallet positions
tools.description: Public on-chain snapshot of a Hyperliquid wallet: account value, withdrawable balance and every open perp position with size, entry, leverage, liquidation price and unrealised PnL. Useful for whale-wallet tracking.

tools.name: get_technical_indicators
tools.title: Get technical indicators
tools.description: Computed technical analysis for an asset from live Binance candles: RSI(14), SMA(20/50), EMA(12/26), MACD, ATR(14) and a simple trend read.

interval.description: Candle interval used for the calculation. Default '1h'.

tools.name: get_market_sentiment
tools.title: Get crypto market sentiment
tools.description: Overall crypto market mood: the Fear & Greed index (current plus recent history) alongside total market cap, 24h volume and BTC/ETH dominance.

history_days.description: Days of Fear & Greed history to include, 1-30. Default 7.

tools.name: list_council_decisions
tools.title: List AI council decisions
tools.description: Recent verdicts from this app's multi-agent AI trading council (bull/bear/quant/risk/trader/PM — quant only runs at 'deep' depth), newest first. Optionally filter by asset symbol.
